resources.string: Applies to newly created direct downloads, static HLS downloads, basic / advanced recordings, and edited media. Saving is always verified in the App Library first. Saving to the album or selected folder creates an extra copy; the App Library original is kept whether copying succeeds, fails, or is canceled.
Save an extra copy to the album
App Library and an extra copy in the selected folder

The selected folder is managed by a system file provider and may sync to the cloud. A copy may become visible while it is being written. You must explicitly select a folder and retain persistent read/write permission; permission is checked again before each new copy is created.

Changes affect only newly created media, not accepted tasks, and do not copy existing media. Changing or forgetting a folder does not revoke its old system permission, so existing tasks or unconfirmed copies can still be processed and cleaned up. You can manage permission in system settings; revoking it may require manual cleanup. Vault is still disabled.
Saving this location choice. Media creation has not started yet…

Saving to the App Library is verified first. Choosing the album or remembered folder creates an extra copy. Later settings changes do not affect this choice; the App Library original is kept in every outcome.
App Library and an extra copy in the remembered folder
The file provider may sync to the cloud. If no folder has been selected, choose one in save location settings first.
Task %1$s · App Library: verified and saved at creation
These records reflect creation time. Later renaming or deletion does not create another copy. For tasks not yet saved to the library, check their individual progress.
